problems.title: Sum of Two Integers
problems.statement: Read two signed integers from standard input and print their sum.

problems.title: Count Vowels
problems.statement: Read one line of text. Print the number of English vowels (a, e, i, o, u), case-insensitively.

problems.title: Is Palindrome
problems.statement: Read one line of text. Ignore case and all non-alphanumeric characters. Print YES if the remaining characters form a palindrome; otherwise print NO.

problems.title: Engineering Roster
problems.statement: The employees table has columns id, name, department, and salary. Write one SQL SELECT query that returns the names of employees in the Engineering department, ordered by name ascending. Return one column and do not include headers.
problems.sql_fixture: INSERT INTO employees (id, name, department, salary) VALUES (1, 'Amina', 'Engineering', 90000), (2, 'Boris', 'Sales', 70000), (3, 'Chen', 'Engineering', 105000), (4, 'Dia', 'Support', 65000);

tests.input: Use the base employees dataset: Amina and Chen are in Engineering; Boris is in Sales; Dia is in Support.
Use the base dataset. Before your query runs, Elena (id 5, salary 98000) is added to the Engineering department.
tests.sql_delta: INSERT INTO employees (id, name, department, salary) VALUES (5, 'Elena', 'Engineering', 98000);

tests.input: Use the base dataset. Before your query runs, Chen's department is changed from Engineering to Sales.
tests.sql_delta: UPDATE employees SET department = 'Sales' WHERE id = 3;
